day_shape: 64 items: CENTCOM confirms active US naval blockade of Iran with 30 vessels redirected, Jerusalem Post reports US/Israel weighing energy-infrastructure bombing and land blockade, Khamenei channel hints at 'other fronts', White House renews Lebanon emergency, heavy regime Strait of Hormuz messaging.

threads.label: US naval blockade and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM said the USS Michael Murphy is supporting a US blockade of Iran, with 30 commercial vessels redirected, two disabled and two boarded as of 31 July, and rebutted Iranian claims that the Strait of Hormuz is closed. Regime outlets Defa Press quoted SNSC figure Zolqadr and MP Zare asserting Iranian sovereignty and warning the 'lock on Hormuz' would tighten.

threads.label: Reported US/Israel escalation planning against Iran
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited reports that the US and Israel are considering a land blockade of Iran and a bombing campaign against Iranian energy infrastructure that could begin over the weekend. Iran International reported the Trump administration outlined new military and financial measures, and Trump convened a Camp David cabinet meeting on the Iran war and gasoline prices.

threads.label: Khamenei and parliamentary messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that studies had been conducted on 'opening other fronts where the enemy has little experience' to be activated if war continues, and a separate message on judicial reform. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf, carried repeatedly on IRIB and Defa Press, called for 'unity around the axis of guardianship' as the condition for a strong Iran.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire framework and Hamas disarmament
threads.summary: The Board of Peace released the full text of a roadmap for implementing Trump's Gaza plan, with a two-week ceasefire intended to finalise Hamas disarmament before Israel withdraws from the Yellow Line. Yashar Party's Gadi Eisenkot warned the framework would 'leave Hamas in power', while a Hamas official said the group would refuse to implement disarmament without Israeli endorsement.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Gaza operatives
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said an airstrike killed Ahmed Hussein Mohammed Kafina, a Mujahideen Brigades commander involved in kidnapping Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or on 7 October 2023. Separate strikes killed Hamas supply officer Muhammad al-Abed and commander Ahmad Ma'in Muhammad Anqar, both linked to weapons smuggling and planned attacks.

threads.label: Iran sanctions, finance and cyber pressure
threads.summary: The White House renewed the national emergency with respect to Lebanon via Federal Register notice, the US DOJ charged Turkish national Mohammad Yousef Hasna with conspiring to provide material support to Hamas, and a Reuters investigation reported an Iranian gambling network moved at least $4 billion through a Dubai crypto exchange. US officials also said Iran was suspected of a cyberattack on over 30 Minnesota municipal water systems.

threads.label: Iran executions and internal repression
threads.summary: Former UN prosecutor Payam Akhavan told Iran International the recent wave of public hangings of protesters amounts to 'murders' and a continuing crime against humanity. Iran International also reported security forces seized a Khorramabad hospital during January's crackdown and transferred wounded protesters to the morgue, while Tehran's prosecutor launched legal action against opponents of the executions.

events.summary_en: Number of wounded in US military increases by dozens. The US Department of Defense, in updating casualty figures for its overseas operations, increased the number of American military personnel wounded in operations related to the war against Iran by 32 in one day. The latest figures released on the official system of the US Department of Defense (Defense Manpower Data Center) through 30 July showed 236 wounded, but this figure increased to 268 as of 31 July.

events.title_en: The Zionist regime's role in Spain's migration crisis
events.summary_en: The Zionist regime's role in Spain's migration crisis. The rush of Moroccan migrants across the Strait of Gibraltar into the Spanish cities of Ceuta and Melilla is the result of a new plot by Tel Aviv and Washington to punish Madrid for supporting the Palestinian people against Israel's genocide. The new migration crisis in Spain has caused tensions within the European Union. In this regard, Italian officials have called for suspending Spain's membership in the Schengen area. Schengen is a system of open borders encompassing 29 European countries that have formally abolished controls at their shared borders. Meanwhile, Spain's Prime Minister on Friday held human trafficking networks responsible for this situation

events.title_en: Zare: Iran's sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz is undeniable
events.summary_en: Zare: Iran's sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz is undeniable. The spokesperson for the Parliament's Planning, Budget and Accounting Commission, in an interview with Defapress, said: Iran has the right, within the framework of national interests and international law, to exercise its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, and no extra-regional power has the right to determine the matter. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important international waterways which, based on international law and geographical position, is under the sovereignty and management of the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Sultanate of Oman. The Islamic Republic of Iran has always stated that regional security must be provided by regional countries and the presence of foreigners not only fails to stabilise but also increases instability

events.summary_en: The condition for a strong Iran is unity around the axis of guardianship / We officials must create space for leadership. Qalibaf, Speaker of Parliament, in the Parliament's coordination council: In the third phase of the revolution, strengthening Iran is the primary issue. After Martyr Commander Soleimani's martyrdom, our late Imam focused on a strong Iran and emphasised it. In the second phase of the revolution, we must focus on this strengthening, one condition of which is unity around the axis of guardianship. We leaders must first create space for the guardianship of the jurist. If we want a strong Iran, we must start from this point. We won the war but we must consolidate and secure the victory, and the country must certainly have hope for the future and a bright vision ahead.
